### Introduction
This section describes the LED status indicators for our M18EV series devices.
### Diagram
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=28a9186e633492c5886404258c42cc38)
##### Status Descriptions:
| Indicator | Solid On | Flashing | Off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recording indicator (1REC) | Card inserted and recording | Card not detected, or card present but not recording | N/A |
| Positioning Indicator (2GPS) | Positioning successful | Module present, but positioning unsuccessful | Module missing or faulty |
| Network Indicator (3NET)| Registered on TTX private platform | Not registered on TTX private platform | 4G and Wi-Fi module error |
